headline: No high finding and no code change. On 11-19 the NY high sheet held 65-66 at about 0.63 for three hours (14:55-17:55) while the DSM and CLI both said 64, because the exact-figure rule missed its gates by 0.06 F and 0.009, and the NY high lock has now come in warm four days running.
